title: Autoscale Scenario Labs — Quarterly program outline for dedicated capacity commitments
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Run a focused quarterly initiative to validate autoscale + reservation hedging strategies for Dedicated pools. The program will run three parallel 'scenario labs' that test: (1) commitment smoothing (staggered reservations and fast-fail); (2) burst-band autoscale with cost guards and SLA tiers; and (3) chargeback and forecasting signals for customer-facing allocation. Outcome: a recommended set of autoscale primitives, guardrails, and pricing/commitment scenarios to include in the next release and sales enablement materials.
goals: Deliver three validated autoscale scenarios with measurable cost & latency impact
Produce playbook and runbook for ops and sales (can be used by Solutions/Sales)
Create a data model for predicting commit hedging benefit for customers
Define success metrics and pilot cohort for Q3 private/dedicated customers
acceptance_criteria: Each scenario lab has an experiment spec, control group, and observed results (latency P95, token cost, failover frequency)
Runbook and decision matrix completed and reviewed by Eng + SRE + Sales Engineering
Pilot cohort of >=3 customers signed up for Q3 trials with clear opt-in terms and success metrics
Cost model workbook populated with scenario-level unit economics and sensitivity analysis
